evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: When a question arrives, a text-only router adaptively allocates a fixed readout budget between recent and event memory, without reprocessing historical frames.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: It outperforms the strongest compressed baseline by 2.21--18.37 points on real-time questions, achieves the best compressed result in five of six long-video settings, and performs best in every NEO-ov 2B setting.
